pooledDescriptiveStatistics.pooling: Descriptive per-window values; sessions never concatenated into one queue or drift trajectory.

interpretation.cadence: All five measured finite sessions have bounded queues and final receive-to-start delay within the existing 8ms scheduling allowance. Finite audio playback is not proof of indefinite live capture stability.
interpretation.headroom: The longest fresh take fails the 480ms conservative reserve even though 600ms cadence is sustained; historical F5 is unchanged.
interpretation.latency: For steady full windows, a note near ownership start waits approximately 820ms before input readiness; a note near ownership end waits approximately 220ms. Measured input-ready-to-publication delay is then added. These are source-time envelopes, not measured perceptual feedback or deterministic Practice verdict latency.
interpretation.drift: Existing F5 long take satisfies the descriptive drift rule. The fresh longest take has elevated late-session values but its formal frozen drift classification remains INCONCLUSIVE. No thermal/GPU-throttling cause established.

recommendedNextEngineeringAction.action: Define and prospectively freeze a product source-onset-to-feedback latency SLO before scheduling/stride optimization.
recommendedNextEngineeringAction.reason: Cadence is sustainable on the measured machine, while the 820ms ownership/future wait plus processing makes UX acceptability a separate product question.
recommendedNextEngineeringAction.subsequentDiagnostic: If required by that SLO, independently investigate long-session GPU/host variability with clock/power/temperature telemetry; no cause inferred here.

knownLimitations: Exactly five audio takes on one host and GPU, not an indefinitely running production microphone.
No temperature, power, GPU clocks, or controlled host-contention telemetry.
Source audio content varies across windows; performance drift is an association, not a causal hardware diagnosis.
Half-open window geometry latency is not a product verdict-feedback measurement.
Raw executor artifacts retain frozen F5 schema; separate run root and study receipts identify these five executions as runtime-only, not additional F5 primary accuracy cells.
